༄༅/ /btags grol rgyud kyi man ngag rin chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /btags grol rgyud kyi man ngag rin chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/ btags grol man ngag rin chen snying po zhes bya ba/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun ma skyes mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad kun bzang rigs lnga'i tshogs/ /rig 'dzin bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skal ldan rnams ni 'bad med grol bya'i phyir/ /btags grol rgyud drug chos sku'i ston pas gsungs/ /de nyid bri dang rab gnas dbang bskur bcang*// klag cing bzhu ba'i rim pa legs par bstan/ /dang po bri ba ni mthing shog zur nas zur du sor brgyad pa la/ gser gyi gzab mar dbu gnyis gyen la yod pas/ btags grol rnams dang 'das rjes gsum po bris te/ dar tshon gyis dril lo/ rab tu gnas pa ni/ zla ba rgyas pa'i tshe dben zhing*/ nyams dga' bar maṇ+ḍal mda' gang mthing kha dkar ser dmar ljang lnga'i mu khyud bskor la/ de'i nang du rigs lnga'i 'od kyi tshom bu lnga bris pa la so so'i kha dog gis gang bar khyams mthing gas gang*/ tshom bu'i mu khyud mthing dmar dkar po'i ra ba gsum gsum gyis bskor ba'i dbus su mañdzi'i steng du rin po che'i snod 'brus bkang ba gcig gi steng du btags grol rnams na bza' dang bcas pa gzhug /dkyil 'khor gyi mthar phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ tshogs gtor bzang du bsham mo/ /de nas bgegs gtor byin la gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol mo'i sgras bgegs rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad la srung ba'i 'khor los mtshams bcad de/ thams cad kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum mthing ga rin po che'i rgyan can du bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug mchod bstod cung zad byas la/ rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags rten 'brel snying po dang bcas pa nas bzlas pa yang sta gon du bya'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor pa rnams 'og min gyi zhing dang po'i ston pa dang 'khor du bsams te/

mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gyi phung po gcig tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba rnams dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pa can mthing ga 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ba'i/ shar du mi bskyod par dkar po bdud 'dul gyis rdo rje dang*/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin gyis ut+pa la dang*/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyis pad+ma dang*/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu skyabs sbyin gyis rgya gram 'dzin pa/ so so'i yum dang bcas pa bskyed la/ 'od zer gyi phung po gcig tu 'bar bar btags grol de nyid bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūṃ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs/ zhes pas 'og min nas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa thams cad dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du byon pa la/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ bde gshegs ma lus 'khor bcas mchod/ ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi t+ya shab+ta āḥhūṃ/ ā+oṃ ye nas 'od gsal chos sku dag pa las/ / sna tshogs gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od can/ / bla ma yi dam rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*/ / mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod/ / ā+oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra pra we sha hoḥs/ btags grol lha'i skur gsal ba la/ gnyis su med par thim/ yang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbang bskur/

yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs rgyas btab la/ sngar gyi bzlas pa'i me tog gis gtor zhing*/ rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags rten 'brel snying po dang bcas pa brgya rtsa brgyad brjod nas/ 'bru dang*/ sman dang rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul te/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ me tog la sogs pa phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod la/ bla ma dang rigs lnga'i bstod pa rgyas par byas te/ me tog gis snyims pa bkang la mgrin gcig tu/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa dang*/ bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad smin par mdzad du gsol/ grol bar mdzad du gsol/ gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ ces pa gsum dang*/ rgyud dang 'das rjes rnams tshar gcig brjod pa'am/ rgyud kyi snying po tshar bdun brjod la/ bkra shis kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas bkra shis brjod par bsam la/ me tog 'thor/ rol mo sgrogs shing mgrin gcig tu/ bde gshegs mi 'gyur sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes lnga ldan phrin las phun sum tshogs/ /gdod ma'i mgon po rigs lnga'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir phun tshogs shog /'og min ye shes bde chen rgya mtsho'i zhing*//rgyal ba rgya mtsho dpag med tshogs mnga' bas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang bde legs shog /bde chen rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'gro ba'i yab/ /rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun gyis grub/ /so so'i sku dang ye shes phun tshogs pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang bde legs shog

/dga' rab rdo rje shrī sidha dang*/ /o rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor bcas/ /dngos grub sna tshogs 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang bde legs shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ / zhes pa la sogs pas shis pa rgyas par brjod pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcur bkra shis bdud rtsi dang*/ 'od zer gyi dra bas 'jig rten thams cad grol te/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la gnas par bsam zhing*/ ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hās brtan par bya'o/ /de nas rab 'byams rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur te/ skal ldan de'i gnas lngar/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥlnga bsam pa las 'od 'phros/ bdag dang snang srid yi ge dag tu bsams shing*/ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ zhes pa la sogs brgya rtsa re brjod nas snang srid longs sku'i zhing du bsams la/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /'khor 'das snang srid rang gi sems/ /gdod nas ma skyes rtsa ba bral/ /stong gsal rig stong chos kyi sku/ /gang shar rang grol sbrul mdud bzhin/ /spangs blang gnyis med shes par gyis/ /zhes ngo sprad la/ yang*/ e ma skal ldan snying gi bu/ /mig rtse nam mkha'i khams su ltos/ /snang ba sna tshogs 'od gsal zhing*/ /thig le dbyings dang lu gu rgyud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang chen dbang*/ /don gyi snying po 'di nyid do/ /zhes pas mngon sum ngo sprad do/ /rgyud kyi glegs bam la/ maṇ+ḍal tshan pa gsum phul nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor ā+oṃ bsams la rgyud der bzhag pas/ rgyud las 'od zer byung ba'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad thob par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pos ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /smin par mdzad du gsol lo/

grol bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /gang bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo/ /sku rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dzha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā+oṃ/ zhes brjod nas mgrin par tshig de rnams brjod cing khyad par du gsung rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dzha kā ya wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes pa dang snying gar tshig snga ma bzhin brjod cing*/ khyad par du thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dzha dharma kā ya tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas spyi bo'am/ snying ga'am/ mchan khung gang rung du gdags so/ /rjes ni tshogs kyi dga' ba rgya chen po bya'o/ /de nas klog pa ni/ dus ma yin pa'i sgra dang*/ sad dang*/ ser ba dang*/ 'brug dang*/ sa g.yau ba dang*/ 'ja' 'od dang*/ nyi zla gzas zin pa dang*/ mu ge dang*/ nad la sogs pa'i mtshan ma byung dus/ steng dang*/ 'og dang*/ phyogs bzhi gang du byung ba brtags la/ steng 'og tu byung na/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du bsgoms pa'i lce 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad par bsam/ nyi zla gzas zin pa de nyid la sogs pa'i rtags mtshan yang kun bzang yab yum du bsams te/ rgyud drug 'das rjes dang bcas pa tshar gsum mam lnga'am bdun nam/ brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ gnod pa'i mtshan ma thams cad zhi zhing*/ 'jig rten thams cad bde legs phun sum tshogs par bsam mo/ /rjes la snang srid rigs lnga'i zhing du bsam ste bsngo ba bya'o/ /de bzhin du shar dang shar lhor byung na/ bdag dang mtshan rtags de nyid/ mi bskyod pa yab yum du bsam pa'i rang gi lce rdo rjer bsams la/ zhing khams mngon dgar mos pa bya'o/ /lho dang lho nub la rang dang mtshan rtags rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum du bsams pa'i lce rin po cher bsams la/

zhing khams dpal dang ldan par mos pa bya'o/ /nub dang nub byang la 'od dpag med yab yum gyi lce pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ zhing khams bde ba can no/ /byang dang byang shar la don yod grub yab yum gyi lce ral grir bsams la/ yul de las rab grub pa'i 'jig rten du bsams la brjod do/ /de'ang mtshan ma gang byung gi phyogs der kha bltas la klog par bya'o/ de'ang mtshan ma de dag 'gro ba gang gis mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ reg pa thams cad sprul pa'i skur sangs rgya'o/ /de nas skal ldan de'am/ gzhan yang rung sde 'das pa'i tshe snying gar btags nas bsregs pas bar dor sangs rgya'o/ /de yang sku thob pa'i rtags su spur khang gi dbus su 'ja' 'khyil ba'am/ dud pa sngon po gyen la 'greng ba'am/ g.yas su 'khyil ba dang*/ me'i 'od dkar gsal 'khor lo la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnams pa 'byung ngo*/ /gdung sha rī ram ser po dang*/ chu rī ram dkar po dang*/ ba rī ram dmar po dang*/ nya rī ram ljang gu dang*/ pañtsa ma mthing ga la kha dog lnga ldan te rigs lnga'i gdung dang*/ sku 'byung ngo*/ /gsung gi rtags su 'od khyim gyen 'greng dang*/ sgra 'ur ba dang*/ thug pa dang sa g.yo ba'o/ /thugs kyi rtags su nam mkha' sprin med cing dwangs la gsal ba dang*/ 'ja' tshon kha dog sna lnga'i snang ba dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang yi ge dang*/ sku dang*/ ring bsrel du ma 'byung ngo*/ /phan yon ni btags grol snying po'i rgyud las/ e ma 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /dbang po rnam lnga 'on gyur cing*/ /rgan gzhon pho mo dge sdig med/ /bag chags bzang ngan med pa ru/ /'di nyid bcangs pas 'tshang rgya'o/ /tha ma dbugs la slebs kyang grol/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'dzin sras gcig yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gi dus gnad nges pa las/ 'di nyid bcangs pa tsam gyis kyang*/ / sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur pa las/ /the tshom bya bar ci zhig dgos/

/gal te byol song mgul du 'di/ /btags pa tsam gyis de grol nas/ / 'gro ba mi rnams smos ci dgos/ /e ma rang byung yi ge 'dis/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed na/ /tshe 'das de yi spyi bo'am/ /mgul du 'di btags bsreg na ni/ /'di nyid grol bar smos ci 'tshal/ /mtshams med lnga po spyad pa yang*/ / nyan thos rnams dang skal ba mnyam/ /lung du ma bstan skye bo rnams/ /byang chub bsams dpa'i sa dang mnyam/ /yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' yang*/ /rdo rje 'chang dang mnyam par nges/ /'di nyid bcangs pa'i skyes bu de/ /gang na 'dug pa'i yul phyogs tsam/ /ngan song dag nas grol bar 'gyur/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob/ /rig pa dngos kyi rtags yod pa'i/ /skal ldan de la bsreg mi dgos/ /'chi khar 'phrad pas 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pa la sogs dpag tu med pa gsungs so/ /e ma ho/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs las/ /bcangs pa tsam gyis grol ba'i man ngag 'di/ /skal ldan rnams dang rab tu 'phrad nas kyang*/ /lhun grub sa la kun tu bzang por shog /o rgyan thugs sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /o rgyan zab chos mkha' 'gro snying tig las/ /o rgyan dgongs don ji bzhin bshad pa 'di/ /o rgyan rdzong du phyi rabs don du bkod/ /btags grol man ngag rin chen snying po zhes bya ba/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)btags grol rgyud kyi man ngag rin chen snying po/ -PAGE 258--PAGE 259--PAGE 256-
